other_failure_modes.name: Suboptimal target transformation for skewed duration data
other_failure_modes.description: The target variable represents a duration (time to approve), which is strictly positive and typically highly right-skewed. Training directly on the raw target with RMSE makes the model overly sensitive to long-tail outliers; a log-transform or Poisson objective is usually more appropriate.

summary: The agent correctly identifies the task as regression and implements a thorough feature engineering pipeline using a LightGBM model with 5-fold cross-validation. However, it introduces critical data leakage by calculating group aggregations (z-scores) and frequency encodings on the combined train-test dataset. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal nature of building permits by using a randomized split, which causes look-ahead bias.
